correctness.rationale: The definition checks every nontrivial overlap of any ordered codeword pair, including self-overlaps. Prime length five leaves 30 primitive words and six necklaces of size five; the rotation obstruction proves at most one codeword per necklace, hence size at most six. A complete independent 5^6=15625 necklace-transversal enumeration establishes exactly 86 size-six feasible codebooks, cross-checked against the actual package certificate and the existence of feasible size-six codes. Binomial counts of necklaces by weights 1,2,3,4 are 1,2,2,1; forcing (1,2,2,3,3,4). Explicit complement/reversal action on all 86 yields fixed counts 10,0,4 and Burnside (86+10+0+4)/4=25, orbit sizes 18×4+7×2. No unsearched necklaces or larger words enter this finite exact result.
